text:
Seeing you triumph beyond the moon over barbarous foes, who would not fear, noble Belisarius, that you made Fortune envious?


These sad tears I owe your extraordinary valor, which hid commanding Marius in oblivion.


Now among beggars, time tyrannizes you, and memory of highest spoils.


Your enemies wished to blind you, not seeing he cannot be blind who has so many eyes in fame.

translation.title: To Belisarius
